meta.title: Match Mismatch → Dispute Case Auto-Creation: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as an AP Executive on a lower-plan tenant and verify Match Mismatch → Dispute Case Auto-Creation is unavailable or refused.
Create a 3-way/4-way match mismatch and verify automatic dispute case creation on a Growth tenant.
Compare the same workflow across lower-plan and Growth tenants while holding the user role constant.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as an AP Executive on a lower-plan tenant and verify Match Mismatch → Dispute Case Auto-Creation is unavailable or refused.; Create a 3-way/4-way match mismatch and verify automatic dispute case creation on a Growth tenant.; Compare the same workflow across lower-plan and Growth tenants while holding the user role constant.

args.need: provide access to the lower-plan and Growth tenants, sign in as the same AP Executive, run Match Mismatch → Dispute Case Auto-Creation for a 3-way/4-way mismatch on both tenants, and report availability, refusal, and dispute case creation

steps.note: The required plan-gated matching and dispute workflow, cross-tenant setup, and AP Executive access are not represented in the catalog.
Check that the tester's resulting screen has no crash or server error, without treating this as evidence of the plan-gated capability.
